system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points — activated.
  • Ritualism rituals — activated.

(House note: FU auto-applies this class benefit — the mechanical field is activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise; the benefit itself is standard Project FU.)

ILLUSIONIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000141]{Illusionist Magic} 【Max SL 10】

One Illusionist spell per Skill Level (twelve exist against a ten-level cap — nobody ever learns the list). Offensive Illusionist spells and Phantasms use (INS + WLP).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000142]{Phantasmal Residue} 【Max SL 5】

Once per round, after your Phantasms shatter as part of a Command spell, gain one Residue (hold up to SL). When casting, spend any number: −2 MP each.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000143]{Phantasmal Recovery} 【Max SL 5】

Shatter one of your Phantasms to recover (SL × 5) HP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000144]{Phantasmal Recycling} 【Max SL 1】

When you cast a spell and cannot afford its total MP cost, shatter one of your Phantasms for a 10 MP bonus toward it — never to create a Phantasm. Triggers only on a genuine shortfall, not by choice.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000145]{The Pledge} 【Max SL 1】

At the start of a conflict scene, spend 10 MP to create one Phantasm. Triggers on the Turn when swapping in mid-conflict.
